description: This is an HTML source file that defines the front-end interface for a database visualization tool. It includes layout, styles, and client-side JavaScript code for interacting with a database server, fetching the list of databases, tables within them, and displaying table data with expandable cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching the database data and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables within a selected database, and loads table info if expanding.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, with a limit of 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table from the fetched data, including handling wide content and nulls.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, with expandable content for lengthy or object data.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability when content is lengthy or an object.
